mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notify_source_channel WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND channel_code = #{channelCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notify_source_channel (source_id, channel_code, enabled, title_tpl, content_tpl, quiet_start, quiet_end, rate_limit_seconds, digest_mode) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{channelCode}, #{enabled}, #{titleTpl}, #{contentTpl}, #{quietStart}, #{quietEnd}, #{rateLimitSeconds}, #{digestMode})
mapper.update: UPDATE notify_source_channel SET enabled=#{enabled}, title_tpl=#{titleTpl}, content_tpl=#{contentTpl}, quiet_start=#{quietStart}, quiet_end=#{quietEnd}, rate_limit_seconds=#{rateLimitSeconds}, digest_mode=#{digestMode} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE notify_source_channel SET enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id}
